description: This file defines functions and constants related to managing and converting availability schedules, including time range calculations, timezone adjustments, and string formatting for availability data.

methods.name: getAvailabilityFromSchedule
methods.description: Converts a weekly schedule into an array of availability objects, aggregating days with identical time ranges.

methods.name: getWorkingHours
methods.description: Converts availability data with UTC or timezone info into local working hours, handling day overflow.

methods.name: availabilityAsString
methods.description: Formats availability data into a human-readable string, including day ranges and times.
